title: Directory Watcher Configuration Schema
description: JSON schema for the configuration file of Directory Watcher.

shell.description: Shell that runs every hook command. Defaults to sh on Unix and cmd on Windows. cmd and powershell (Windows PowerShell) are available only on Windows.

global.description: Global configurations applicable to all watch targets.

path.description: Path of the directory to monitor.

lifeCycle.description: Lifecycle hooks for this watch target.

onStartWatch.description: Commands to execute when starting to watch this directory.

onChange.description: Commands to execute when a change is detected in this directory.

onFinishWatch.description: Commands to execute when stopping watching this directory.

exclude.description: Path patterns, relative to path, of files and folders to exclude from watching. Patterns are globs with ** and are checked in order; a pattern starting with ! watches a path excluded by an earlier pattern again. A matched folder and everything below it are not watched.

waitMillisecond.description: Wait time in milliseconds after an event occurs before executing the hook.

watchFileEvent.description: File events that run the hook (C: create or move in, U: update, D: delete or move away), or none. watchFileEvent and watchDirEvent cannot both be none.

watchDirEvent.description: Folder events that run the hook (C: create or move in, D: delete or move away), or none. A folder event stands for the folder and everything in it.

dirEventWaitMillisecond.description: Quiet time in milliseconds after the last event before collected folder events are sent. 0 uses the default.

dirEventMaxWaitMillisecond.description: Longest time in milliseconds that folder events are collected. 0 uses the default.

noWait.description: Whether to execute the hook immediately without waiting after an event occurs.

interruptible.description: Whether to stop the currently running command and execute a new command.

onStartWatch.description: Commands to execute when starting the monitoring process.

onBeforeChange.description: Commands to execute before a change occurs.

onAfterChange.description: Commands to execute after a change occurs.

onError.description: Commands to notify once when the first fatal error wraps fsnotify.ErrEventOverflow. Error context is passed in DW_ERROR_* environment variables.

onFinishWatch.description: Commands to execute when stopping the monitoring process.

anyOf.description: A command line run by the configured shell. Write template variables such as {{.Path}} outside quotes.
An object specifying the command and the directory in which to execute it.

dir.description: Directory path where the command will be executed.
